message.content:
A medium-sized tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 kcal**.  
The calorie content varies with size:

| Size (approx. weight) | Calories |
|-----------------------|----------|
| Small (≈90 g)         | 15 kcal  |
| Medium (≈123 g)       | 22 kcal  |
| Large (≈182 g)        | 33 kcal  |

These figures are averages; actual values can differ slightly depending on variety and ripeness.
